yaml:
type: Wbs
diagram:
  meta:
    source: |
      @startwbs
      * Crown
      **[#pink] _ Birch
      ***_[#gold] Elm
      --[#cyan] _ Fir
      @endwbs
  nodes:
  - label: Crown
    color: null
    depth: 1
    side: Right
    children:
    - label: _ Birch
      color: '#pink'
      depth: 2
      side: Right
      children:
      - label: Elm
        shape: None
        color: '#gold'
        depth: 3
        side: Right
        children: []
    - label: _ Fir
      color: '#cyan'
      depth: 2
      side: Left
      children: []
interpretation: Whitespace separates _ Birch and _ Fir from color command fields: they are literal labels with default Box (omitted shape). Adjacent ***_[#gold] Elm is shape None. Java new-order command handles these without old-order warning. The maker recategorization is correct; it does not waive shape_colors_old or wbs_shape_color.
